runner.name: Managed V8 research runner
runner.descriptor: ManagedV8ResearchRunner v1; SOLUSDT 4h; causal EMA50/200; Wilder ATR14; training-only q33 ATR/close and q99 absolute log return; Donchian close breakout excludes current bar; next-bar-open fill; stop 1.5 ATR; target 2R; max 12 bars; adverse-first intrabar; one position; 15bp round-trip proxy; historical funding settlements with exact markPrice or flagged 4h-open proxy when absent; incomplete funding trades excluded; 3x3 validation-only parameter grid; chronological splits; 12-bar purge; moving-block bootstrap length 5, 5000 reps, xorshift32 seed 0x12345678.
runner.sha256Scope: Descriptor string only; not the executable runner source.
runner.reproducibilityStatus: PARTIAL: exact managed-V8 runner source was not committed as a runnable repository file; repository backtest harness was not invoked.

data.transportEvidence: Connector payloads only; HTTP status/headers and /fapi/v1/time are not exposed. Direct shell DNS probes failed.
data.rawOhlcvPersistenceStatus: Input OHLCV hash is recorded and the archive base plus gap-repair deltas/correction are present; canonical archive reassembly/readback is still pending.

selectedParameters.selectionReason: Highest validation mean net R among candidates with >=30 complete-funding trades; tie-break smaller lookback then smaller stop.

tradeDefinitions.win: netR > 0 after 15bp round-trip proxy and observed funding cashflows
tradeDefinitions.targetBeforeStop: TARGET/TARGET_GAP; both-touch bars count as stop
tradeDefinitions.riskPerTrade: stop distance in quote units per one SOL

interpretation.reason: The untouched test was evaluated once after validation-only parameter selection. Promotion requires >=100 OOS trades per symbol/context, positive net expectancy, credible uncertainty and robustness; no promotion was made.
interpretation.multipleTesting: Nine parameter combinations were evaluated on validation only; no test-period parameter search. One symbol/context OOS hypothesis.
limitations: 15bp fee/spread/slippage is a proxy, not account-specific or historical order-book calibrated.

3,501 early funding markPrice fields were blank; 3,452 were approximated from the nearest 4h open and 49 remained unpriced. Any trade crossing an unpriced funding event is excluded from metrics. OOS requires zero proxy/unpriced funding events.
Historical depth and realized slippage are unavailable.
This is a separate managed-V8 runner, not the repository backtest harness.

Exact managed-V8 runner source is not persisted; the recorded runner SHA-256 covers only the descriptor string. Re-run in the repository after Node >=24/npm >=11 setup for full code-level reproducibility.
